scope: Require documented source, density, microenvironment, reproducibility, quality metrics and variability across preparations.

title: Robbins et al., Goal-directed learning in cortical organoids, Cell Reports 2026
scope: Adaptive feedback learning on task, but no retained improvement after tested 45-minute rest.

title: Cai et al., Brain organoid reservoir computing for artificial intelligence, Nature Electronics 2023
scope: A bounded hybrid neural-computing precedent, not a full semantic mind.

title: Williamson et al., Learning-associated astrocyte ensembles regulate memory recall, Nature 2025
scope: Mouse in-vivo astrocyte recall evidence; does not establish organoid memory storage.

title: Dewa et al., The astrocytic ensemble acts as a multiday trace to stabilize memory, Nature 2025
scope: Mouse slow-state stabilization candidate; nonportable to organoid without tests.

title: Taga et al., Human spinal astrocyte influence on motor neuron maturation, Stem Cells Translational Medicine 2019
scope: Spinal regional co-culture maturation, not general learning.

title: Osaki et al., Reciprocally connected cerebral organoids, Nature Communications 2024
scope: Axonal joining precedent, not memory transfer.

title: Tsokas et al., KIBRA/PKMzeta memory maintenance, Science Advances 2024
scope: Mouse memory maintenance pathway; candidate Root mechanism.
